subject.title: [codex] Verify Telegram topic proof for cron delivery

question: After the rich-message fallback proof bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept this PR's documented plugin-facing `validateDeliveryResults` hook and fail-closed non-General Telegram topic delivery semantics?
rationale: Repository policy treats plugin APIs and fail-closed delivery behavior as compatibility-sensitive; code review can identify the narrow repair, but maintainers must choose the permanent SDK and upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept Hook And Fail-Closed Contract
options.body: Land the generic post-send validation hook and Telegram fail-closed semantics after fallback proof capture and focused tests are fixed.

options.title: Keep Validation Telegram-Internal
options.body: Ask the author to remove the shared SDK hook and implement the proof check through Telegram-owned delivery code only.

options.title: Request Native Cron Topic Proof
options.body: Ask for current-head Telegram Desktop cron-topic proof before making the API and upgrade-policy decision.

recommendation.title: Accept Hook And Fail-Closed Contract
recommendation.body: Land the generic post-send validation hook and Telegram fail-closed semantics after fallback proof capture and focused tests are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is primarily SDK/channel contract policy, and steipete has the strongest recent history on plugin SDK and outbound seam design.
